verdict.rationale: ADK is fundamentally code-first: agents are built via the Python API (google-adk-docs-1, google-adk-docs-2, google-adk-docs-13), and the built-in Web/dev UI (google-adk-gh-3, google-adk-gh-4) is a testing/debugging layer for those same agent objects, implying most UI actions trace back to underlying API/code constructs. However, the pack never explicitly states or demonstrates full functional parity between the UI and the API/CLI, and probes show no published OpenAPI/REST surface (google-adk-probe-3), leaving programmatic access to some UI-only conveniences (e.g., Agent Config's no-code builder, google-adk-gh-1) unconfirmed. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, evidence that no-code/UI-only features (Agent Config, dev UI actions) have equivalent API/CLI calls, and a documented REST/OpenAPI surface for non-Python clients.
